plain.family: seamed K x K carrier + p x q block
plain.method: certified branch and bound over (L, cx, cy): a box is pruned when its forced bed exceeds the count law's demand or its possible bed falls short of it; an empty box list is a proof

box.note: per row p+q <= isqrt(2k^2-1): the whole box, every shape whose bbox fits below the grid side, not a cap

p+q <= isqrt(2k^2-1) is every shape whose bbox fits below the grid side; the side interval ends at the delivered side minus the noise margin, and the search is over K <= k-1 (K = k is the grid itself)
